data.allocation_rule: Department cue IDs and exact triggers remain null until allocated in the responsible controlled department document and concurred by required roles.
data.safety_rule: TECH and FIN relationships cannot execute from this crosswalk; controlled approval, department concurrence, readiness evidence, and applicable safety authority are mandatory. HOLD, ABORT, and STOP override timing.
